","feedlabel":"Community Announcements","date":1788832393,"feedname":"steam_community_announcements","feed_type":1,"appid":1364780},{"gid":"1842846814454209","title":"Arjun brings his cinematic mantra to Street Fighter 6 on October 13!","url":"https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1842846814454209","is_external_url":true,"author":"stwks_65c7aa44","contents":"[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/9b3be215e88000d2e0549536af371b599bccece5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Breathe. Feel the energy flow through your body. Just breathe. And focus on these words: Arjun is coming to Street Fighter 6 on October 13. Whisper those words back to yourself for you’ll need all the patience you can muster to face this brute of a man hellbent on revenge.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="b3SvMJvr998;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/4990d1d6a8e572e93a83278a37f0f4d534d01fcc.jpg"][/img]Before we begin, I want you to set your intention. That is, find it within yourself to walk in the shoes of Arjun. You see, he was once a police officer in India with a partner he would take a bullet for. Until one day, his partner was murdered and he was framed for the unfortunate event. Now Arjun searches for the truth behind these events vowing to let only his last breath keep him from justice. That’s right, a breath because that’s what I want you to do. Breathe in for three seconds. Now breathe out. Let’s begin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/918c24c7c0732b76952beb14c71b61f319b18329.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/fe1a45db26c0348c4fc0653c47924ad053719d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let’s start with the Tree pose. Stand on one leg and place the sole of the other on your thigh while bringing your hands together and reaching your arms up. This will help you understand Arjun’s battle plan. What he lacks in speed he makes up for in power, projectiles, and traps, but what makes him even deadlier is the core of his move set: dealing recoverable damage, also often known as gray life in fighting games. As a reminder, recoverable damage is vitality that will heal over time if left untouched, but if you are hit, all of it will be removed in one fell swoop. As you will see, Arjun’s special moves will slowly turn your vitality gauge gray even if blocking. Then he will attempt to deplete it all in one seamless maneuver.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3aed66c28e22ecd7da4b51dd4276c851e2917924.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/9c56edfc3e893276556da492691e1c512edeffe9.jpg"][/img]Next, I’d like you to do the Warrior II pose. Engage your core as you take a wide stance, bend the right knee, and stretch your arms out to prepare for Arjun’s Arm of Justice, a versatile winding punch that will sap energy. A move that is safe on block for light and medium and plus on block for heavy. Arm of Justice has a follow-up attack that will allow him to be plus on block as well. The OD version of Arm of Justice is faster on start-up and is also plus on block. This move deals recoverable damage on block as well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/157704eef21db40c5ed7e4478a0dd8f4e77facac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/eaa8105a489c701ad5feaad3646e718715ac0e5e.jpg"][/img]Let’s do the Triangle pose next. I want you to stretch that right hand as high as you can to prepare for Cruel Shoulder, a lunging forward tackle. The light and medium versions are not safe on block. The heavy version is slow but is plus on block. The OD version behaves the same as the heavy version but is faster on start-up. You’ve been paying attention because I see you noticed this move also deals recoverable damage on block.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/177a2818a68b77944d0ccaae7f77c3c72931736c.jpg"][/img]Breathe. Inhale. Exhale. Now for the Warrior I pose, much like Warrior II, but your hands clasped above you, activating your lungs to truly understand how Arjun uses Breathing Ring, a ring of air made through body and spirit. Arjun can follow up with Breathing Shockwave to send the ring forward as a projectile. The button pressed determines the angle the gust will blow. The OD version of the ring will last longer, travel faster, and hit more times. Your mind is focused since you realize this move deals recoverable damage if blocked.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/687956afc0ba23194ffc893844946b16e045a9fa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/8fbecce9f6a8e6469919314c538d3e7f90f819a8.jpg"][/img]Flow in the Downward Facing Dog pose to engage your core and become a mirror of the Divine Pillar. Arjun blows enough air into the ground to raise the earth into a spire where the strength of the button determines the distance. Hold the button down to delay its activation. A new spire will always replace the last and a spire will disappear if Arjun is hit. Arjun will use this move to apply pressure, especially when you are getting off the ground.[/p][p]If Arjun uses Cruel Shoulder while a spire is active, Justice Beyond activates where he grabs the spire and swings it toward the enemy, regardless of the side they’re on. The OD version of Divine Pillar starts and erupts faster opening up even more pressure tools. Yes, a blocked Divine Pillar and Justice Beyond deal recoverable damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/4bf3cbc7e47d9ae6f3a8a58e9ad43d5943ed7952.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ad11db929edf5d5230918cc70d64fb72fd62748a.jpg"][/img]Now sink into the Bridge pose to simulate what your body will experience when Arjun uses Ghastly Interrogation, a command throw that only deals recoverable damage, but if you already have recoverable damage, it deals normal damage. During the OD version, Arjun takes a step forward before attempting the throw. He will seek to weave this move into the fight to catch blocking opponents off-guard or after a successful Justice Beyond.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/351e878eb9e2697cf6e36ed255b175222ead00db.jpg"][/img]Turn around and perform the Cat-Cow pose, arching your back up and down to prepare for Indomitable Defense. Arjun uses his yogic breathing to hyper oxygenate his muscles and can walk back and forth in this state. Any strike at him will result in a counterattack dealing only recoverable damage. This also works on projectiles but will not result in the counterattack.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/843249619879c2050cf91c720efb6770ca242021.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ebb1d7f400b9912ea3e00e3642d4f479cf764c63.jpg"][/img]While in this state, Arjun can throw both his fists forward to activate Moral Breakdown, a move that is plus and deals recoverable damage on block or normal damage on hit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/13229026cbe10c5fc687c141af8c8bab0e324d9a.jpg"][/img]Arjun’s Level 1 Super Art Howling Destruction sees him mowing you down with quick bursts of breathing technique. Invincible on startup and can easily hit opponents in the air.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f0ab5ea393918245f5332ed93419d25f60c0ede2.jpg"][/img]During Arjun’s Level 2 Super Art Instant Oblivion, he sends you flying into the air and far away from him where he can set up a Divine Pillar.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/38fee7b93fcba8044c69b2090b4c2324232c380a.jpg"][/img]The last pose I want you to practice is the Happy Baby pose because you’ll want to feel all the joy you can before being struck by Arjun’s Level 3 Super Art Yaksha’s Order. Arjun disrupts your inner ear and has you seeing visions before he performs a cinematic devastating attack.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/832f63c7e7d90d8733da611a5393d204d430186d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/870fbb9e88d8d04c1447b4b685cb521cadf5fccc.jpg"][/img]Arjun’s Outfit 2 reflects the ideal version of himself having escaped his life on the run and his days as a police officer. Earn this outfit by maxing his Acquisition Gauge in Avatar Arcade Mode or with Fighter Coins.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5957bb87a8ca1a7075de055b873593c4f13c0a93.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/4ef56bf3a880bf1eb62564285cdf82609e4f9dc3.jpg"][/img]The Year 4 passes are available now and the Ultimate Pass includes additional costumes and colors! Owners of the Year 4 Ultimate / Character Pass will have Arjun unlocked when he releases on October 13. Year 4 also includes three more characters: Yasmine, who is already out; Tifa from the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series coming next; and Bosch from World Tour to close it out.[/p][p][/p][p]Now lie on your back. Savasana. Thank you for this yoga session. Namaste.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c4693b8ce96788bf79e2325f1f435a256e0c2cb0.jpg"][/img][/p]","feedlabel":"Community Announcements","date":1788822930,"feedname":"steam_community_announcements","feed_type":1,"appid":1364780},{"gid":"1839676055894097","title":"Yasmine is out now!","url":"https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1839676055894097","is_external_url":true,"author":"capcomjapan_marketing","contents":"Yasmine, the first Year 4 character, joins the fight!

The first character from Year 4 is one of two brand new characters joining Street Fighter 6 alongside the other newcomer Arjun, the iconic Tifa from the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series, and Bosch from World Tour. Hailing from the Philippines, Yasmine seeks to slice and dice her opponents in Eskrima, the national martial art of the country. Wield her blade with the start of Year 4 on August 3, 2026![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="M5vxJpSsM_M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/82a5ab5a202b4bd5f01202dd5164a782dc384056.jpg"][/img]Yasmine learned how to fight alongside her Kuya (older brother) from her Lolo (grandfather). Initially, she trained simply because she wanted to spend more time with her Kuya, but he mysteriously vanished one day, making her lose any inspiration to fight and ended up doomscrolling on FooTube. Until one day, she stumbled upon a certain French supermodel’s videos, reinspiring her to go out into the world, hoping she’ll cut a path that will lead her right to her Kuya.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/fd89023df396f70286c530bb2b201e163a9fc722.png"][/img][/p][p]If you play rushdown characters, you’ll feel right at home with Yasmine as she zips and glides around to confuse opponents before slicing them right in the face with her trusty knife. Pair this with her lethal Bayani Mode and she’ll make each fight worthy to go viral on FooTube.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/6ebe77c4a63de80b77db84763e599679196b1d00.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/95c194ca28ee39dd44f8985fc11312ea36f06202.jpg"][/img]Daloy ng Tubig is a quick forward-moving knife attack that’s good in combos. Follow-up with Alon where Yasmine does a multi-slice hit and a different final hit depending on the strength used. The OD version can combo from a light attack and into Super Arts. It also powers up Alon into a devastating slice that’ll send opponents spinning and won’t take Yasmine out of Bayani Mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/618af028c14a877eaec16cdc39fe0542fcbf8924.jpg"][/img]If Alon connects, Yasmine goes into Bayani Mode and her knife will glow blue. Using Alon in Bayani Mode will result in a different powered up final hit. Using the light version in Bayani Mode ends in a knock down, medium version will end in a ground bounce, and the heavy version ends in an even higher launcher than normal. After this hit, Bayani Mode will dissipate.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/777a0952472d156d6ae9e548a0ae3d6556f5175d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/70ad83ba9e81eefc9919895e0294369248ca8e3a.jpg"][/img]Talim ng Hangin is where Yasmine spins forward and sweeps with her knife, useful for closing the gap or taking an opponent by surprise. The light version is a good fake out while the medium and heavy versions will carry her forward. The medium version is safe on block and the heavy one is plus although it comes out pretty slow. And of course, landing this move puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode. The OD version is not safe, but if it hits, the opponent gets launched for a follow-up attack. Madaling sabihin, mahirap gawin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/e948868298d419ad9a5004a0dcd951e1a2e61936.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/7bc0a92c3fc16a7f9ab4eecf3a6ec5cf8b27c641.jpg"][/img]Leap into the air with Mukha ng Langit, a front flip with two follow-up attacks. The button pressed determines how far Yasmine goes. The first follow-up attack is called Kulog where Yasmine swipes like an eagle’s talon. It’s safe on block and she can start a combo with a light attack if it lands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/11322ab7ea8dab45d84cb9ae6c3a463c7a568d00.jpg"][/img]The second follow-up is called Ulan, an upside-down spinning attack that hits backwards, so it’s best to aim for behind the opponent. The OD version of all three of these attacks makes it safe or plus on block, so go ham with it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/95e8853b105589579f33825547db3a15ee5856fd.jpg"][/img]Lipad ng Agila sees Yasmine kicking into the air in a flurry of hits. A great anti-air and tool for ending combos. The OD version is invincible on startup to keep the bullies away.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c987acb632e55e7f26e149e660a4558326b1004e.jpg"][/img]Here’s where things get real tricky! Pangil sa Likuran is a projectile move that swirls around like a boomerang. The strength of the move determines how far it goes. It’s a tad slow coming out but is scary for its mix-up and combo potential. Don’t leave yourself open since it’ll disappear if you’re hit. The OD version of the boomerang hits three times, opening even more opportunity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/7d0c8c39894d02487193708d3c9475b04739350f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/cdb9f3ee8b0ff1156ea8468e4f1876dce0e36551.jpg"][/img]Yasmine’s Level 1 Super Art is Hiwa ng Kalangitan where she kicks her opponent in the air, then slams them back down. It has invincibility on startup so it’s useful as a counterattack or a “get off me.” Landing this also puts Yasmine in Bayani Mode.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/86a9cf740eeae100b11c91031e0784a0ea6a2add.jpg"][/img]Nakatagong Lakas is Yasmine’s Level 2 Super Art. She focuses her energy and for a limited time, she can use boosted special moves without leaving Bayani Mode. She can also use Linya ng Liwanag during this Super Art where she dashes past an opponent and attacks them from behind. Street Fighter 6 Year 4 knuckles down for another year of pulse pounding pugilism, as four new characters arrive to showcase the meaning of Unbridled Strength. The Year 4 roster features iconic special guest Tifa from the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series, the brand new fighters Yasmine and Arjun, and the second protagonist of World Tour Bosch!

[previewyoutube=9dxDjF_dOXc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Character Introductions
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ee06b61556085e0b0ffd7eaed4c3c17b0620c72b.jpg[/img]
■Yasmine
A highschooler hailing from the Philippines joins the fight to search for her long-lost Kuya. Despite her shy and gentle demeanor, Yasmine beams with confidence whenever she uses her crescent-shaped karambit knife to dance around her opponents at high speed just like her Lolo taught her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3698b6d84898499e7f1905b6a9d8f455d67a3273.jpg[/img]
■Arjun
Uses extraordinary lung capacity combined with yogic breathing to unleash explosive power with his unique Bare-knuckle Yoga techniques. While working as a police officer in India, Arjun was accused of killing a colleague and now lives on the run while he searches for the true culprit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/212b8eb0abd50d336b7530e333e9952ad98a024f.jpg[/img]
■Bosch
Departed his home nation of Nayshall to pursue the true meaning of strength and eventually wins the sacred martial arts tournament. His travels brought him to Metro City where he trained under Luke to incorporate modern combat methods into the ancient techniques of Nayshall’s warrior faith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/680f9989ebb1e86705ab4e018b6f994de8fa064b.jpg[/img]
■Tifa
A highly skilled practitioner of Zangan-ryu Martial Arts and a member of the Avalanche resistance group. During her journey with her companions, she is unexpectedly transported to another world where she encounters and bonds with new fighters. Tifa excels in close-range combat, combining martial arts techniques with unique powers called Abilities.

Ingrid here to talk to you directly about how wonderful I’m going to be when I join the Street Fighter 6 roster on May 28! Wow, we’re already on the sixth installment. Feels like just a few seconds ago when I graced you with my presence, albeit not in any mainline series. How do you Terrans say it? “It’s been a long time coming” and some obsession with the numbers “6 7” that you all started saying. Sigh, Terran civilization has a long, long road ahead of it.
[/p][previewyoutube="iwp56gLGqh8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/978a970e77e10db68854fa3c56dbbfbf617bbbb2.jpg"][/img]I, Ingrid, the extradimensional woman of mystery, first appeared in Capcom Fighting Evolution in 2004 and then tore another fabric of reality to Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX in 2006. Back then, you weren’t using any of these “leverless controllers” I’ve been seeing in your dimension, but it makes me giddy to see more ways to play. After all these years, I sensed a worrying singularity appear, so I decided to see where it led, and poof, I’m in Street Fighter 6! Ohohoho![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/1c0dac884d975224e8da388e904cfd14fe29e8fa.jpg"][/img]Now I know you’re either busy with your 9 to 5s or your homework or running your little errands, but if you’re curious how my cosmic powers manifest, I’ll indulge you. Meet me in World Tour where you and I can increase our bond. Don’t worry, I’m going easy on you Terrans. If I used the full extent of my powers, you wouldn’t exist to read this blog on something called “Steam.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2e10e2a8a90b905c800c4228c712232127b453e2.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/09a51dc452a6f4a265c9ca6a983bcc42a6b39c3b.jpg"][/img]Let’s start with Sun Shot where I shoot a dazzling ball of light in front of me that briefly stops before launching away like your hopes and dreams. Depending on the button you press and how long you hold it, I can change the speed and angle. The Over…drive… (what does that even mean?) version of Sun Shot adds more hits and force! The best thing about OD Sun Shots are that you can fire them while regular shots are still lingering to create a stunning display of lights across the screen. That’s your cue to “ooh” and “aah.” 
 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b2daf92ace40d8e214ef6ea1e42b3d7a7f57187f.jpg"][/img]If a ball of light seems fleeting to you, then behold my Sun Flare where I shoot a beam of light forward. Before I explain, I want to let you in on a little power of mine called Sun Crests. I infuse myself with the power of the sun and can have up to 4 of them at a time. Use the light version of Sun Flare to see me do a cute cosmic girl pose… and to store one Sun Crest. Hold the button down to store them faster. Sun Crests increase the number of hits, range, and follow-up potential for the heavy and OD versions of Sun Flare. Up to 2 Sun Crests are used at once.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f38c87c15a7875d79e7ae437a1db29dd9435f601.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5396a8e0ed68f219ea13b66ef410905b9610ce29.jpg"][/img]In your dimension, the sun comes from above, so I have an ability called Solar Burst where I shoot a beam of light downward while in the air. Like Sun Flare, use the light version in the air to store a Sun Crest and the other versions to use them up for amplified properties.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/1b5460d2274b01ecaacc3f216ef8f391f1e46908.jpg"][/img]You funny Terrans make a big deal out of the sun appearing every day so I named this next move Sun Rise, a spinning attack akin to my past move set. The light version is a great anti-air. The medium version is useful for combos and can be canceled from light attacks. The heavy version requires a bit of finesse, but if it connects you can follow up with moves like Solar Burst. The OD version is safe on block and the third attack of the move can cancel into a Super Art.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c812418c0f77fcd8dee8f7571b7176f4a559a350.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c4facfdfa17058080042c5e9e5a14d420943e2f2.jpg"][/img]You’ll have trouble landing a hit on my glorious form with Sun Veil, a counterattack where I nullify an attack and drop your tush back where it belongs (away from me!) While it can absorb projectiles, it won’t stop Super Arts or any attack that hit multiple times. The OD version comes out much quicker and is a great option after getting knocked down. In case you’re wondering, I’m letting you knock me down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/11d370800896f80123ec42b5a7207e3d6cf593b7.jpg"][/img]
One last special move: the daring, the dramatic Vanishing Sun! I can teleport with three options to really keep you guessing. Pressing forward teleports me forward with a kick attack and is safe on block. Pressing down teleports me above you where I unleash a downward attack. It’s not really that fast coming out, but on the flip side, it’s plus on block. Pressing back teleports me away from you so I can observe how silly you are from a distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2f1e18bcf2ba32940e37565c51235e38b2386a74.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b32878c1a0b887d3c42d8af827ddc15f36a3a1b0.jpg"][/img]On to my Super Arts starting with my “Level 1” Shining Sun where I attack in a series of magical kicks. It’s invincible on start-up of course as so many “Level 1s” are. The best part is I’ll expend one Sun Crest to power up the attack, but if I have multiple stocked up, I can hold the button down to use up another to wrap you in ribbons of light. Yes, that means more damage and I end up on the other side of the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/7dff8c103378dbab310217f82111d3dadb38e445.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b780acaa665bd87b0f570d3080edc85db4eb7be2.jpg"][/img]My “Level 2” Super Art is Order of the Sun. I fire a beacon of light into the sky and depending on the button pressed, a shower of solar power rains down upon thee. With Sun Crests stocked, holding down the button will result in an increased amount of these shooting stars. After firing off this move, the stage is set, the audience is seated, and it’s time to see how well you can dance! See if you can block all my hits, kay?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ed130edfd844e1a993f13968333630b4c95e019f.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/e0f5e4508264fdd4079a3b2a4b8240d24634e51d.jpg"][/img]Finally, I can show off my true power with my “Level 3” Cosmic Ray. I can fire this off even on the other side of the screen and if it connects, you’ll get a glimpse of my ultimate power.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/6dbd922eaf5dc8d66ea7451f3317155b731dea38.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5f07b6d9cf69b6f09c36f45eadd00753963df902.jpg"][/img]My Outfit 2 is inspired by my first appearance complete with my stylish purple schoolgirl uniform.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5c92b89d7620adeb3418e72e86f3161eed36cfa2.jpg"][/img]Let me get the script out real fast and read it out loud to you: *ahem* “Owners of the Year 3 Ultimate / Character Pass will have the woman of mystery unlocked when she releases on May 28. As the final character of Year 3, all four characters from the pass will have their Outfit 3s come out at the same time.” I guess that’s it for now. See you in a few weeks. Bye-onara! [/p][p]Check out more details on our blog below.[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1364780/view/247268204255117318"][/dynamiclink][/p]","feedlabel":"Community Announcements","date":1769076033,"feedname":"steam_community_announcements","feed_type":1,"appid":1364780},{"gid":"1822556746157802","title":"Alex enters the Street Fighter 6 ring on March 17!","url":"https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1822556746157802","is_external_url":true,"author":"stwks_65c7aa44","contents":"[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/7c9605e47f58c46f0a5d2dfe2ba04e68111e33bb.jpg"][/img]Hailing from the Big Apple, it’s the brawler who puts the bomb in Power Bomb! Coming in at 245 pounds and with enough muscle to bench press the entire stadium, this New York native will show he’s the undisputed champion when he enters the Street Fighter 6 ring on March 17. Let’s hear it for ALEEEEEEEEEEEX![/p][previewyoutube="i1fqbyMXt1Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/cb37ebd7887bc1eadb0da087814a2c86f0b6bba1.jpg"][/img]First appearing as the protagonist of [i]Street Fighter III: New Generation[/i] in 1997, Alex was raised by his mentor Tom, who has a daughter Patricia. After being challenged to his fair share of street fights, he now works as a pro wrestler who is awaiting his next reason to fight, whatever that may be.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b6958abd42ca470b70526837153924312f4cc842.jpg"][/img]All the time on the streets has made Alex’s moves quite the spectacle, but now with his pro wrestler career, he’s incorporated new moves into his routine. We’re talking a scary new stance, over 10 throws, and moves that transition into others. Oh, and he’s no longer a “charge character.”[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/39c4e6a57036257d2aba40d684d1885f966e9050.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/043ebea5439509978a835d98148ebcb6d924628f.jpg"][/img]Cover your eyes! Alex is ready to blind opponents with Flash Axe and Flash Chop! Flash Axe is performed with a fireball input with light or medium punch. The light version is a great combo ender and is safe on block whereas the medium version can transition into Prowler Stance upon hit. More on that later![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/0f135ec2f07149572731ae83f4ab0f2b1c2d164a.jpg"][/img]Flash Chop is performed with a fireball input and heavy punch. When this bodacious move hits on the ground, the opponent will get all turned around and be open to a follow-up grab like Power Bomb or Oblique Stomp for some wicked damage. Flash Chop is also plus on  block. The OD version allows Alex to transition to Prowler Stance on hit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2545d38e90ec31d68a42c4ba4ce26435eed6dd94.jpg"][/img]Look out from below! Aerial Knee Smash is a fantastic anti-air technique as Alex jumps into the air and slams his opponent into the ground with his knee. The light and medium versions don’t hit standing opponents, but are quick. Meanwhile, the heavy version isn’t too great an anti-air, but can be combo-ed into and also hit standing opponents. The OD version comes out fast and will result in a hard knockdown.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3b6669248cfb228f95734c35527672505c8d448c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f6644bb5588fd2087e5781d2a93a1f340f6830e6.jpg"][/img]Alex is ready to be the main event with his signature Power Bomb! While all versions of the move result in the same damage, the range and speed differ. The light version has the most range, but is the slowest while the heavy version has the least range, but is the fastest. A unique property of Power Bomb is that if the opponent has their back to you, like after a successful Flash Chop, it’ll transition into Power Drop, which results in even more damage and switches sides. If the OD version grabs an opponent from behind, and you hold forward, it’ll transition to Hyper Bomb, increasing damage and allowing you to select which side to end on.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ff9c87dc24178b7a98c28beeba1db45a65252dcf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a0cdac0ec5eb3fd44c243f5ab2fc29939280661f.jpg"][/img]This move has got some gusto! Introducing Prowler Stance, a new star to Alex’s move set that will keep opponents on their toes. First off, Alex can’t block while in this stance, but that won’t matter with the 11 different follow-up options. There’s far too many to go over in detail, so let’s just provide quick highlights.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/dfd00378de9cc9d8d22e744459cb0713a9d87d90.jpg"][/img]Pressing heavy punch after Prowler Stance results in his trusty Heavy Lariat, a move that is plus on block and has armor if held down. It also turns the opponent around upon counter hit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/6c120de948be3f57f9e4d65e4af43caf93fe981d.jpg"][/img]Upon pressing light kick, Alex performs Tactical Hop, a quick hop where you can follow-up with any aerial attack. And pressing medium kick will get Air Stampede, a quick stomp from the air.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c75a953a6f0132db03131010b12aec1e970a5853.jpg"][/img]From Prowler Stance, if you land Sweep Combination (Target Combo), Hyper Takedown (Throw), or Dangerous Armbar (Throw) on a Punish Counter, they’ll transition into Flying Suplex, Death Valley Bomb, and Spiral DDT respectively.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3e241c75ca539671074ff8a5378c1c955571cdc9.jpg"][/img]Have fun figuring out Prowler Stance![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c37d7bba7e805065d3bdd9058870e301fbb402db.jpg"][/img]Alex’s Level 1 Super Art is Raging Spear where he springs forth with a devastating tackle. This move is invincible on start-up to both strikes and throws. It can also be used in combos.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a1ca059b4470701449f7c3bdf7fbd686c139e24a.jpg"][/img]The opponent is gonna feel this tomorrow! Alex’s Level 2 Super Art Sledgecross Hammer crushes opponents with a devastating lariat that can wall splat if it hits an airborne opponent. It also has some invincibility to it for projectiles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2d58753622beb4f8ae89d54c7852b571b7ed469c.jpg"][/img]The crowd is gonna go wild! In Alex’s Level 3 Super Art The Final Prison, the wrestler chokes the opponent out with a series of phenomenal grappling moves that will have his opponents wishing they were apprehended in any other way. Ouch! Someone call the whambulance![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/1c886de4edc9ab9e40a51dbf92c62cccfd65b85c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3f604d925f54ca6224109b10208cd22950b0733a.jpg"][/img]Let’s hear it for the hometown hero! Like other legacy characters, Alex’s Outfit 2 is inspired by his appearance in [i]Street Fighter III[/i] with his trademark green pants and red bandana. Get this with Fighter Coins or by maxing out his bond in World Tour.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/42eacfe3a47e103690ed2a867d54925bdf5bae33.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/d3e6bd53c8834e42f0d06e515156fc6812b60a62.jpg"][/img]Finally, anime song super band JAM Project has composed Alex’s theme for [i]Street Fighter 6[/i]! We’ll release the full song “GO! ALEX! Hope is Born!” soon, but in the meantime, you can hear a bit of it in the gameplay trailer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c972014da2844d18c5ba4352dd4fb0080a8ac85a.jpg"][/img]What’s that at the end of the gameplay trailer? Alex has another Level 2 Super Art? Yes! After a successful OD Power Drop, Alex can transition into Omega Wing Buster. We wonder why this move looks so familiar… It might be because wrestling superstar Kenny Omega performed some of the motion capture for Alex! BANG![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f7dec01096e6affc09d73d0cbbf03a8d33ae832d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2cda88e8b777770b298a3d76bb341068ce35064e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On March 17, your winner will be the Man with no Allies, ALEEEEX! Ready to get thrown around? Viper will start her experiments on October 15 in Street Fighter 6!","url":"https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1811772772213248","is_external_url":true,"author":"stwks_65c7aa44","contents":"[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/63abf8044d484bb3b6f624a48681adcae8d61a63.jpg"][/img]Our hypothesis states that the release of C. Viper in [i]Street Fighter 6[/i] will appeal to players who enjoy a technical character or those who like to see a stage lit up with special moves. We have a large crowd of test dummies waiting in the wings, ready to assist in this hypothesis. We will give our green light to start the experiment on October 15, when test subjects far and wide will get their hands on Crimson Viper.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="o7ziu2cpNZk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/dc0bb2aae3cb057c3b3ddf782a82f72600ad5b8b.jpg"][/img]Our records state that C. Viper first appeared in [i]Street Fighter IV[/i] in 2008 as an undercover agent on a mission to collect more data for her projects. In [i]Street Fighter 6[/i], she is now a research director for SiRN under an alias and deals with cleaning up ex-Shadaloo figures. This will be important as we examine the subject further.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/37faeca3b77716b1dc2239eb477f26fa20b87278.png"][/img]To support our hypothesis, we must first look at the various gadgets at C. Viper’s disposal, many of which were observed in her last iteration in Street Fighter IV. These gadgets offer her command of three elements and serve as the source of her flashy technical requirements. However, our research has indicated that C. Viper will also utilize the Drive Gauge in ways that no other subject has before. More on that farther down on this paper.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/6406f1ddc4e8aff0a91250f2d65175fc39069f4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b91c6e16b7c4796c8e952d51ad23c69c7540a07b.jpg"][/img]Let’s start with our first observation: electricity. When C. Viper uses Thunder Dash, she delivers an electric shock with a gadget hidden in her gloves. The heavy version of this attack makes for a good anti-air.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/ea038a81c32927d7a7a31cad0ca33576828c01f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f191dcd2cabb8131b7634250aa98e0c3f30fa0d9.jpg"][/img]We discovered something new with this iteration of C. Viper. The aforementioned Thunder Dash can transition into Tracer Combination, a follow-up dash attack, but this special move will use up one bar of Drive Gauge. C. Viper can also perform a Feint with this move, tricking opponents into overstepping. The OD version of Thunder Dash travels farther than the light and medium versions and is observed to be less risky on block.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/704f126dbb5c6ccd9c84505aac51e97c60c8a2ea.jpg"][/img]Moving on to our next observation: flames. C. Viper uses Burning Kick and leaps forward before scorching opponents with a special gadget hidden in her fabulous shoes. The distance traveled depends on the button used and all versions are safe on block.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/81332b89a5e0dc33af3d76cb44591c8a4d1ab0b2.jpg"][/img]Follow-up Burning Kick with Knuckled Pursuit, a forward dash which provides an additional hit if Burning Kick lands. If C. Viper is feeling extra hot, she can follow up Burning Kick with Double Burn, a flaming kick with both legs that is plus on block. Both Knuckled Pursuit and Double Burn use up one bar of Drive Gauge, further proving our hypothesis.[/p][p]C. Viper can use Burning Kick in the air to really keep her opponents guessing. The light version drops straight down while the medium and heavy versions maintain her jump momentum. This move is perfect for a nasty cross-up or ambushes from afar.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/c3e8b7aff84c56089aee56df3bd9b25a7d3956fd.jpg"][/img]Our third observation are seismic shocks, scientific name: Seismic Hammer. C. Viper uses gadgets in her gloves to send a shock wave through the ground. As with her other moves, the button pressed determines the distance. She can also perform a Feint with this attack to keep opponents on their toes.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/d80f124e46f609b11d3148ebce89426c06a6f0e6.jpg"][/img]When C. Viper feels threatened, she can use a brand new move called Focus Force where she puts a protective barrier in front of her before releasing a kick. This barrier can absorb attacks with armor and can be held down to absorb more hits or canceled with a forward dash. Our research tells us this move is inspired by a phenomenon called a Focus Attack in [i]Street Fighter IV[/i]. This move can also break through a Drive Impact when used at just the right time. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/905e1fb1a773b4ce8fdaa73138f64d2dd2de58a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/bcdde3b04ede3d9fc5762c1d8ece57c3dddadfe0.jpg"][/img]We were pleasantly surprised to discover that C. Viper also has a High Jump, which is performed by pressing up right after pressing down. This can be performed in neutral, after all normal attacks (except sweep), or after Seismic Hammer. High Jump costs one bar of Drive Gauge and is an advanced technique that will further support our hypothesis of the special agent being a technical character.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/51892af761d487da046220398869c1a949b2abf3.jpg"][/img]Limit Decoupler is C. Viper’s Level 1 Super Art. This one requires special attention to understand the details. After an upward kick, C. Viper pushes her heels to maximum potential as they light up the fight. During this install, she no longer uses up Drive Gauge when performing a High Jump or the special move follow-ups allowing for increased pressure. This works even in Burnout with the caveat being that the rest of the install gauge will deplete if one High Jump or special follow-up move is used.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/e9274164792c64bd806fbe6ad48bbb3b131024ed.jpg"][/img]Mission Complete is C. Viper’s Level 2 Super Art where she makes full use of all her gadgets in a spectacle for the eyes. This move has full invincibility on start-up and is also useful to close out combos.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/852bb5c21c3cbdd35cf8508b0e374200245732ea.jpg"][/img]And our last piece of supporting research is her Level 3 Super Art, Hard Luck Rejector, where she launches opponents into the air with her heels before driving them into the ground with her gloves.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f90d61fd91ec87378c7301ecce58a08b0a5c24dd.jpg"][/img]C. Viper’s Outfit 2 is inspired by her look in [i]Street Fighter IV[/i] featuring her business attire and signature red braid. Get this with Fighter Coins or by maxing her bond in World Tour.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3d7196b693cf4830aa8ece36b67e8c63dfec265e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In conclusion, we believe our hypothesis is proven with C. Viper’s unique kit made possible by her gadgets. Extreme management of her Drive Gauge will surely shine in the right hands. Owners of the Year 3 Ultimate / Character Pass will have the research director unlocked when she releases on October 15.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a45f6ef9dd01a88111605b090c431b624d77bae5.jpg"][/img][/p]","feedlabel":"Community Announcements","date":1758724826,"feedname":"steam_community_announcements","feed_type":1,"appid":1364780},{"gid":"1811138915421181","title":"Sep. 26 is Marisa's Birthday!","url":"https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1811138915421181","is_external_url":true,"author":"capcomjapan_marketing","contents":"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/7417e7dd56f88168aa1a83b64607efbdadea8b88.jpg[/img]

Elena, the final character from Year 2, charges into Street Fighter 6 on June 5 and brings with her a herd of moves that’ll make for elephantastic fights!

[previewyoutube=2X_QyoQ2YBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/40b1db4de2af16073b729a41157c87860747273e.jpg[/img]
 Hailing from Kenya, Elena first appeared in Street Fighter III: New Generation in 1997. She’s always pawsitive, even in the face of danger, and makes friends as easily as she can hear the voices from nature. In Street Fighter 6, after an intense fight with her friend Akuma, she travels the world once again in search of the meaning of a lesson that Akuma teaches her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/75d90d931526a1258c57bf04830ad3d9dd290e46.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a306820f3fa57cbdea2b6c2540aeed9f87456d5a.jpg[/img]
As a capoeira master, Elena utilizes her long legs and unpredictable movement to keep her prey in check. Many of her moves from prior games remain intact, but as usual, we’ve updated her move list in Street Fighter 6. We’re not lion when we say “unpredictable!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a6749af0600594982459d40aa5cebaa4fd6dbdd1.jpg[/img]
   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/32953c239653aa5103e30bd742dbb8a8e4f20a61.jpg[/img]
Rhino Horn is a series of quick, forward-moving kicks that send the opponent flying back. Elena will jump farther depending on the strength of the kick used. Though this move can’t hit crouching opponents, if you land it in the corner, you can follow-up with Scratch Wheel. Speaking of Scratch Wheel, it’s a powerful rising kick, and acts as Elena’s “dragon-punch,” and is useful for anti-airs or for keeping opponents off her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/8289c2b7eb778ea85e276e3f9f88882e9cb8c39b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/cf00a61bb1c491ec86c59d40430a378e42496077.jpg[/img]
Sink your teeth into Lynx Song because its where things get wild! Elena spins forward close to the ground while invincible to projectiles and can then use four different techniques out of it. The first is Leopard Snap, a long-reaching attack useful for getting in. The second is Harvest Circle, a kick that launches opponents in the air and maintains invincibility to projectiles. The third is Mallet Smash, an overhead kick that can buffalow-profile. The fourth is Lynx Whirl: the move you should be standing alert for like a prairie dog!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/21c9b6ec512d706831265777386ddcc5353fdf9c.jpg[/img]
During Lynx Whirl, Elena performs an additional spin to extend Lynx Song. If the aforementioned Leopard Snap, Harvest Circle, or Mallet Smash are performed after Lynx Whirl, their properties are “boosted!” A boosted Leopard Snap makes Elena “plus” on attack and block. A boosted Harvest Circle gives Elena more time to follow-up attacks on hit, opening up more combo options. A boosted Mallet Smash is quicker and makes Elena “plus” on attack and block. OD Lynx Song provides all the benefits of Lynx Whirl without having to spin the second time. Remember this move before opponents call you a cheetah!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f4f13bfbbce3edc1f83d7058707e8eb0a6b7a242.jpg[/img]
Spinning Scythe is Elena’s move from her past iterations where she performs a series of spinning kicks. The kicker here is that she can cancel Spinning Scythe into the aforementioned Lynx Whirl, which can then be followed up again with Leopard Snap, Harvest Circle, or Mallet Smash. As you can see, Elena’s special moves transition from one to another and then another after that with multiple options to keep pressure and oki. She isn’t monkeying around with Lynx Whirl and can send the opponent lost in the plains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/dc477b80216727ebc2e724a56fd061843922d07c.jpg[/img]
Finally, Moon Glider is an evasive technique where Elena steps back before performing a vertical spinning kick sending the opponent in the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/54ee4cd5e45fe3d39cef017bfd929b86360a05a1.jpg[/img]
For the eagle-eyed, Elena’s Level 1 Super Art Meteor Volley is an effective anti-air and also allows for a follow-up attack on hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/55bd0460434dbcaca02266b511dcf0fe74c1d783.jpg[/img]
And now the moment you’ve all been waiting for! During Elena’s Level 2 Super Art Revival Dance, she launches forward with a flurry of kicks and is invincible to all attacks on start-up. If Elena is feeling a bit drained, she can forego some of the extra damage and use her trademark healing to gain some Vitality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/bcf7f69b5bf3824d945bbbfec269fea4f010d606.jpg[/img]
Finally, Elena’s Level 3 Super Art Song of the Grasslands brings the power of nature to the fight as she delivers kicks with the power of the skies and plains!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/344629e27adc7e1a4db19eff5140f3e1fcc73b58.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/bccbb354c04d1e5233bd3c441e51f1ccc90f2220.jpg[/img]
Elena’s Outfit 2 is her iconic outfit from the Street Fighter III series and Ultra Street Fighter IV. You can earn this outfit by maxing out her bond in World Tour or by spending Fighter Coins in the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/490d54e3ac9c011d3a49266ef403c286f00af264.jpg[/img]
 Elena comes with a brand new stage, Reniala Remains! Visit the plains of Africa at night as wildlife roam in the background, all lit by the glowing moon above.

Finally, there will be a major balance patch when Elena releases, meaning changes for all of the previous 25 characters and some system changes as well. Keep an eye out on our social channels and website for the patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5e802b9e12097142eb9281b17cd648cb3e250f59.jpg[/img]
 Elena is the final character from Year 2 and we can’t wait for you to play her and find the optimal paths for your playstyle. She’ll make sure all your fights are never a boar! She can be purchased with Fighter Coins and will be automatically unlocked for owners of the Year 2 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass on June 5 or if you get the Years 1-2 Fighters Edition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/32953c239653aa5103e30bd742dbb8a8e4f20a61.jpg[/img]
Rhino Horn is a series of quick, forward-moving kicks that send the opponent flying back. Elena will jump farther depending on the strength of the kick used. Though this move can’t hit crouching opponents, if you land it in the corner, you can follow-up with Scratch Wheel. Speaking of Scratch Wheel, it’s a powerful rising kick, and acts as Elena’s “dragon-punch,” and is useful for anti-airs or for keeping opponents off her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/8289c2b7eb778ea85e276e3f9f88882e9cb8c39b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/cf00a61bb1c491ec86c59d40430a378e42496077.jpg[/img]
Sink your teeth into Lynx Song because its where things get wild! Elena spins forward close to the ground while invincible to projectiles and can then use four different techniques out of it. The first is Leopard Snap, a long-reaching attack useful for getting in. The second is Harvest Circle, a kick that launches opponents in the air and maintains invincibility to projectiles. The third is Mallet Smash, an overhead kick that can buffalow-profile. The fourth is Lynx Whirl: the move you should be standing alert for like a prairie dog!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/21c9b6ec512d706831265777386ddcc5353fdf9c.jpg[/img]
During Lynx Whirl, Elena performs an additional spin to extend Lynx Song. If the aforementioned Leopard Snap, Harvest Circle, or Mallet Smash are performed after Lynx Whirl, their properties are “boosted!” A boosted Leopard Snap makes Elena “plus” on attack and block. A boosted Harvest Circle gives Elena more time to follow-up attacks on hit, opening up more combo options. A boosted Mallet Smash is quicker and makes Elena “plus” on attack and block. OD Lynx Song provides all the benefits of Lynx Whirl without having to spin the second time. Remember this move before opponents call you a cheetah!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/f4f13bfbbce3edc1f83d7058707e8eb0a6b7a242.jpg[/img]
Spinning Scythe is Elena’s move from her past iterations where she performs a series of spinning kicks. The kicker here is that she can cancel Spinning Scythe into the aforementioned Lynx Whirl, which can then be followed up again with Leopard Snap, Harvest Circle, or Mallet Smash. As you can see, Elena’s special moves transition from one to another and then another after that with multiple options to keep pressure and oki. She isn’t monkeying around with Lynx Whirl and can send the opponent lost in the plains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/dc477b80216727ebc2e724a56fd061843922d07c.jpg[/img]
Finally, Moon Glider is an evasive technique where Elena steps back before performing a vertical spinning kick sending the opponent in the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/54ee4cd5e45fe3d39cef017bfd929b86360a05a1.jpg[/img]
For the eagle-eyed, Elena’s Level 1 Super Art Meteor Volley is an effective anti-air and also allows for a follow-up attack on hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/55bd0460434dbcaca02266b511dcf0fe74c1d783.jpg[/img]
And now the moment you’ve all been waiting for! During Elena’s Level 2 Super Art Revival Dance, she launches forward with a flurry of kicks and is invincible to all attacks on start-up. If Elena is feeling a bit drained, she can forego some of the extra damage and use her trademark healing to gain some Vitality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/bcf7f69b5bf3824d945bbbfec269fea4f010d606.jpg[/img]
Finally, Elena’s Level 3 Super Art Song of the Grasslands brings the power of nature to the fight as she delivers kicks with the power of the skies and plains!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/344629e27adc7e1a4db19eff5140f3e1fcc73b58.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/bccbb354c04d1e5233bd3c441e51f1ccc90f2220.jpg[/img]
Elena’s Outfit 2 is her iconic outfit from the Street Fighter III series and Ultra Street Fighter IV. You can earn this outfit by maxing out her bond in World Tour or by spending Fighter Coins in the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/490d54e3ac9c011d3a49266ef403c286f00af264.jpg[/img]
 Elena comes with a brand new stage, Reniala Remains! Visit the plains of Africa at night as wildlife roam in the background, all lit by the glowing moon above.

Finally, there will be a major balance patch when Elena releases, meaning changes for all of the previous 25 characters and some system changes as well. Keep an eye out on our social channels and website for the patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/5e802b9e12097142eb9281b17cd648cb3e250f59.jpg[/img]
 Elena is the final character from Year 2 and we can’t wait for you to play her and find the optimal paths for your playstyle. She’ll make sure all your fights are never a boar! She can be purchased with Fighter Coins and will be automatically unlocked for owners of the Year 2 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass on June 5 or if you get the Years 1-2 Fighters Edition!

Bouncing in from SNK’s Fatal Fury series, Mai Shiranui promises to be the good girl you dream of when she arrives in Street Fighter 6 on February 5. As the second guest character to ever grace a Street Fighter game, Mai will dazzle each match with fans, flames, and ferocity.

[previewyoutube=kMPlI_oj2VQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/57735ba024f3ddd1c59bf4b1304ccd9085242bbe.jpg[/img]
 
Mai first appeared in Fatal Fury 2 (1992) and was characterized by her love of all things beautiful and her flirtatious attitude. She also has a deep infatuation with Andy Bogard, Terry’s younger brother. That infatuation leads her to Metro City where she thinks Andy has visited, but in her search for her Prince Charming, she stumbles upon other personalities that challenge her skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/8f5bb1b18d2b710988dc38707862f8093886d601.jpg[/img]
 
You’ll want to play Mai for two huge reasons: ninja trickery and mastery of aerial attacks . Though fans of hers can expect to be familiar with her move set, her Street Fighter 6 iteration has unique properties to spark some creativity. Let’s start by saying all her special moves are motion inputs, so no charging required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/78b2c8a1ee2fa37f479b582893bcad71cfdb00be.jpg[/img]
 
In a match, Mai uses Kachousen, throwing her cute fan like a fireball. When used normally, the fan loses to other projectiles and your opponent’s strikes can knock them down. But when you hold down the input, they can no longer be neutralized by strikes. In addition, if the fan hits an opponent (on block, as well), it will pop up and fall down on them for another hit. Where the fan falls depends on the light, medium, or heavy button pressed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/1cad1b98014e913914aadf3dbe2b28242db0f779.jpg[/img]
 　
The OD version of Kachousen throws a multi-hitting fan without having to hold down the button. When you do hold them down though, Mai will throw two fans that don’t pop up with the option to follow up with Midare Kachousen, allowing her to throw an additional two more fans for a total of four. There are even more property changes to her fans, but we’ll get to Flame Stocks later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/97cf4c20485656be2e83af13537431b3808e12a9.jpg[/img]
 
Ryuuenbu sees Mai spinning forward in a fiery blaze for combos or to control space. When used at a distance, the tip of the light version is safe on block, and when the heavy or OD version hits, Mai can follow up with another attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/3ff6d444fd7e94a020a7ff3c67f4396ad2c566e6.jpg[/img]
 
During Hissatsu Shinobi Bachi, Mai does a cartwheel and flies towards the opponent to elbow them. The distance traveled depends on the button pressed and she can go quite far. The OD version sends her into the air to follow up on the attack or to surprise opponents below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a4118e07f2051bd7ec78c6cff08042007f5e5d76.jpg[/img]
 
Hishou Ryuuenjin is Mai’s dragon punch and works as an effective anti-air as she delivers a flying upwards kick bathed in flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/8ec4b33bb25535abfc28f4599446eff4bb9a5fe6.jpg[/img]
 
We know everyone loves a divekick! Luckily, Mai has her own version called Musasabi no Mai, a dive tackle from the air that can surprise opponents. This can only be used during a forward jump or after her target combo Hien Ren Kyaku where she becomes airborne after launching herself off her opponent. The OD version of Musasabi no Mai sends opponents in the air on hit and can be followed up with additional attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/b92d9d46155d759d4b152133549bf54ddd084ed3.jpg[/img]
 
In Mai’s Level 1 Super Art, Kagerou no Mai, she sets the immediate vicinity on fire, which is useful as an anti-air or combo ender and is invincible on start-up. Remember those Flame Stocks? Using Kagerou no Mai will give her five Flame Stocks, which gives all of Mai’s special moves above and Level 1 and 2 Super Arts additional properties such as more hits or damage. There’s too much to detail out with Flame Stocks and their effects, so we’ll leave that for you to experiment with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/38fe8b2077e9eac3ade8983d03987b21046f7430.jpg[/img]
 　
In Mai’s Level 2 Super Art, Chou Hissatsu Shinobi Bachi, she rushes forward in a blaze of glory that can get around projectiles. There’s also an air version which can be used to end air combos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/65b3741d66b34c0d7eda8e09dddfffdefaa88c25.jpg[/img]
 
Finally, in Mai’s cinematic Level 3 Super Art, Shiranui Ryuu: Enbu Ada Zakura, the kunoichi flies like a butterfly and stings like a bee in a series of elegant fan strikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/2c266922588277730f1cf807ee639cb16ea6c0c3.jpg[/img]
 
Mai’s Outfit 2 is inspired by her new look in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, which comes out this April. Get this outfit with Fighter Coins or by maxing out your bond with her in World Tour—something tells us a lot of you bad boys and girls will be doing this.  
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a46223fc3a0b5f2819b0cbc2697ad1f94669bc01.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954094/a586aba95c98538e7497206ce59964cb2d8fa873.jpg[/img]

The Alluring Kunoichi can be purchased with Fighter Coins and will be automatically unlocked for owners of the Year 2 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass on February 5. Our scouts tell us more footage of Mai will be released in the coming days, so keep an eye out to see what more she has to reveal.
